parsed.name: 三路可编程直流电源
parsed.description: E3631A 是一台台式三路可编程直流电源，可为实验电路、电子模块和原型系统提供稳定的直流电压与电流输出。它支持多通道输出、输出开关、远端感测以及电压、电流、功率测量，常用于电子测试、器件供电和实验室台架搭建。
parsed.description_en: The E3631A is a benchtop triple-output programmable DC power supply used to provide stable DC voltage and current to circuits, electronic modules, and prototype systems. It supports multiple output channels, output enable control, remote sensing, and voltage, current, and power measurements, making it suitable for electronics testing, device powering, and general laboratory bench work.
